paragraphs.text: Jenrik was a mysterious astronomancer living in a tall tower on the Silver Beach of Innistrad's province of Nephalia .

The mortar of Jenrik's tower has been mixed with sand from the beach, making it glitter in the moonlight. Inside, he conducted his work studying the stars, eschewing all contact with the outside world. He made observations of the moon , charting its path across the heavens.

The only person welcomed by Jenrik was the moonfolk planeswalker Tamiyo . She spent months poring over his countless charts and adding her observations. On her instigation, Jenrik went to Markov Manor to question Sorin Markov about recent celestial disturbances . As the vampires were about to catch him and feast on him, someone ripped the castle apart and trapped the vampires and Jenrik in the walls. Jace Beleren later found Tamiyo's journal, and pried it from Jenrik's petrified hands.
After Jenrik's demise, his old friend and colleague Vadrik took up the burden of his work.
